definitions.explanation: Arriving after the scheduled or expected time.

examples.japanese: {遅刻|ちこく}しないでください。
{電車|でんしゃ}が{遅|おく}れて、{会社|かいしゃ}に{遅刻|ちこく}した。
examples.english: The train was delayed, so I was late for work.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{毎朝|まいあさ}{遅刻|ちこく}する。

notes:
Functions as both a noun and a suru-verb ({遅刻|ちこく}する).

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{遅刻|ちこく}する (to be late)
・{遅刻|ちこく}の{理由|りゆう} (reason for being late)
・〜に{遅刻|ちこく}する (to be late for ~)

USAGE NOTE:
In Japanese business and school culture, punctuality is highly valued. {遅刻|ちこく} is taken seriously and often requires an apology or explanation.
